source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 23 May 1964, p. 2 ("Two contests likely in Omagh Rural: Co. councillors get a clear field")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the elected members and their party labels read in the Ulster Herald of 23 May 1964, p. 11.

note: Triennial election of Strabane Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There were no contests: the political representation remained 20 Unionists and 8 Nationalists, with three members to be co-opted at the first meeting. The only change in personnel was in Leckpatrick, where Mr. John R. Boak (U.) replaced Mr. James K. Stevenson (U.), who retired for business reasons. William Mehaffy. Returned unopposed.
